limitations: No exact pg_net request/response or cron-run identifier correlation: restricted Folio roles cannot read cron, net or Vault.
The request ID and hostname were not returned in the connector log output; the query was scoped to the root-verified canonical production deployment.
Empty baseline log results are bounded observations and do not prove every earlier invocation was absent.

No application HTTP call, manual worker invocation, deployment or remote mutation was made by the log observer.
Recovery used a simulated expired lease, not a killed hosted process; it does not establish AI, billing, email, Sheets or original-storage recovery.
